mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM kb_doc_chunk c JOIN kb_document d ON c.doc_id = d.id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.doc_version = d.version AND d.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY c.embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT c.* FROM kb_doc_chunk c JOIN kb_document d ON c.doc_id = d.id WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.doc_version = d.version AND d.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.content_tsv @@ to_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery}) ORDER BY ts_rank(c.content_tsv, to_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery})) DESC LIMIT #{topK}
